summary.text: Delisha Boyd is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 102, representing Orleans, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2021 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Delisha Boyd's occupation as Real Estate Broker and Notary Public.

It lists Delisha Boyd's education as Bachelor of Business Administration; Master of Business Administration (concentration in Organization Management); Doctor of Business Administration Candidate (abd).
The House member page lists Delisha Boyd's committee assignments as Commerce; House and Governmental Affairs; Retirement; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus (Vice Chair); Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Orleans Delegation.
